evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic warning delivered with urgency — the speaker frames an unrehearsed rollback as no rollback at all, a high-arousal negative framing of risk.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a preparedness gap into an existential claim that the capability itself is absent?
